text: After [a parasitic fungus turns most of humanity into ravenous "hungries"|threat|sickness and poison], a handful of infected children are imprisoned at an army base in the Home Counties, taught in a classroom and studied for a cure. Melanie, the brightest of them, adores her teacher, Miss Justineau, even as Dr. Caldwell [prepares to dissect her|wrong|harm done to children]. When the base falls, Melanie leaves with a small band of survivors across an overgrown London, toward a [tower swallowed by fungal growth|images|plants, trees and fungus] that could end the world.
